summary: Transform graph JSON into 3D library nodes and links
description: Transform serialized graph JSON into {nodes, links} for 3d-force-graph, with color from node_color and size from node_size already applied.
scope: nodes items have id, name, color, val
links items have source and target
color comes from node_color(type) and val from node_size(fan_in)
acceptanceCriteria: to_force_graph(graph) returns nodes with id, name, color, val and links with source and target matching caller_id and callee_id.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add UI, watcher, or CLI code unless this task explicitly requires it.
Do not mount a browser canvas in tests.

subtasks.title: Build {nodes, links} with color and size
subtasks.summary: Pure transform. Use node_color and node_size. No canvas.
